name: azul_widgets_a_start_asks_the_app_for_its_dom_once
description: E76 (2026-11-28): a cold start builds the app's DOM ONCE and lays it out once; nothing the platform does after the first picture (the window gaining the focus, the first resize event at the size the window has, the app becoming active, the system bars and the insets arriving) asks for the app's layout() again. The QA's cold-start lab printed `layout_begin #2 reason=RefreshDom` 7 ms after the first picture of AzWidgets on every Android start and 58 to 93 ms after it on every iOS Simulator start: the same picture, 0.3 to 0.9 s of the engine's time on the emulator, and it ran the app's whole layout() again. The counters count since the window opened (every file runs in a process of its own): exactly one DOM regeneration, after 2.5 s of nobody touching the app, which is more than the second layout takes where it still happens.
